mentions.name: Web-based image editor (Photoshop-like)
mentions.description: This web-based image editor offers plenty of customisation and support for most Photoshop features. It is built overwhelmingly in vanilla JS with a couple of WASM modules, and is generally very performant across the app, though a handful of features still need performance improvements.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a web-based image editor with plenty of customisation and support for most Photoshop features.

Built overwhelmingly in vanilla JS with a couple of WASM modules for it.
mentions.author: davidsojevic
